name: Gasai Mamoru
source:
A second-year student.

Joined the tennis club during his first year at Akeba Academy, but he couldn't handle the extroverted energy there and transferred to the art club at the start of his second year.

Upon joining, he promptly became the art club girls' toy and was immediately saddled with the humiliating nickname of "Prince Senpai." He happens to be self-conscious about his height.

Also, although he'd never admit it, he's secretly into complicated otaku girls.

Mamoru Gasai is his official name, though it can be changed.
